blocks.x: A favorite of backpackers, outdoor adventurers, and national park wanderers alike, Cotopaxi is known for its deceptively spacious bags, outdoor gear, protective clothing, and colorful styles. I’ve spent my fair share of time trekking up and down the country with my own Cotopaxi bag (Cotopaxi Allpa 35L Travel Pack), which has seen such sights as Acadia National Park and downtown Boston, and on a recent trip to Italy, my travel partner brought hers along the Amalfi Coast.

With sturdy construction; fun, unique designs; and plenty of different styles available in everything from daypacks to rain jackets, scoring a deal on Cotopaxi’s excellent gear means saving big on your next adventure through the great outdoors. Whether you’re headed somewhere remote and forested or through a string of big cities, this is gear made to last.
Get a 15% Cotopaxi coupon code for your first order

First-time Cotopaxi customers can snag 15% off their first purchase. To score this deal, simply create a Cotopaxi account by signing up with your email and phone number. You’ll get a one-time-use promo code to take 15% off one full-price item. If you’re interested in making a bigger purchase, like one of the larger backpacks, this is a great time to use your Cotopaxi coupon code, especially on newer items that don’t often go on sale.

Plus, once you sign up for an account, you’ll receive information to your phone and email about new product arrivals, deals, and more, so you’ll be the first to know when any of your other favorite pieces go on sale in the future. This also means you’ll be able to keep track of what Cotopaxi is up to and see their latest styles before anyone else. The offer excludes sale items and gift cards, and can't be combined with any other discounts or promotions.
Save up to 60% off caps, gear, and bags for fall getaways

Summer is on its way out, so now’s the time to score major savings on your favorite items for any upcoming fall or winter travel. You can find past-season items up to 60% off, as well as current-season items in the sale section for up to 40% off. Expect massive deals on Cotopaxi’s sale page, like 60% off a Tech 5-Panel hat, 50% off the final sale Vaya 18L daypack, and 60% off the women’s Quedo flannel shirt. Whether you’re headed to the mountains or going for a walk along the beach, Cotopaxi’s clothing and gear are all the support you need for an excellent vacation. There are also plenty of deals to take advantage of on outerwear, clothing, packs, and accessories in a variety of colors.
Save up to 90% on pre-worn Cotopaxi styles

Shop secondhand to save big on all your favorite Cotopaxi styles. Customers can trade in their used items for credit that they can then spend on future purchases. It’s easy to do so: just request a free shipping label, package up your lightly used items in any box, and earn credit for eligible items that sell. Cotopaxi only accepts clean, non-damaged items from any brand. Be sure to check the website before sending things in to make sure they’re eligible—and to get an understanding of what general amount of credits you could earn.

If you’re in the market to shop, not sell, you can browse all of the pre-loved products on Cotopaxi’s website. Pick from a variety of clothing pieces and gear (when available) that are still in tip-top shape but cost up to 90% less than when buying new.
Free standard shipping on orders over $99

Another great bonus, especially if you’re looking to make a larger order, is Cotopaxi’s offer of free standard shipping on any orders that are over $99. Whether you’re purchasing one major item, like the Allpa 50L Adventure Travel pack ($310), or want to bundle a few smaller products that you’ve had your eye on—I’m looking at the Del Día Nido accessories bag ($50) and the Atajo long-sleeve waffle V-neck ($75)—as long as all of the products in your cart total to at least $99 before tax, you’ll be able to receive free economy shipping to addresses in the US. Free standard shipping is expected to arrive two to six business days after the shipping date.

This is also a great time to shop Cotopaxi’s fall 2026 collection as the weather starts to cool down, which includes a ton of excellent travel essentials for all types of trips. Expect daypacks, packable jackets, hiking pants, totes, and more, so whether you’re camping in a national park or exploring New York City, you’ll be all set for your next adventure.
What to do if your Cotopaxi promo code isn’t working

Struggling to get your Cotopaxi coupon code to work? There are a few reasons you may not be able to apply your discount to what’s in your cart. Before you reach out to Cotopaxi’s help center, there are a couple of things you can do at home. The first step is to ensure that you’re typing in your promo code correctly. A few common errors include accidental spaces, capitalization, and lookalike characters like the lowercase letter “L” and the number one. If all seems to be correct, the next thing to consider is the code’s terms and conditions. Expiration dates, minimum spend requirements, and product exclusions can all be the culprit behind your issues. From there, consider clearing your cookies and cache, restarting your browser, or switching to a new device altogether to rule out any hardware or software issues.
